claims.value: Llama 3.2 is a foundational large language model released by Meta on September 25, 2024, licensed under the Llama 3.2 Community License. It is distributed as machine-learning model code, trained model weights, inference-enabling code, training-enabling code, and fine-tuning enabling code.
The model supports English, German, French, Italian, Portuguese, Hindi, Spanish, and Thai languages.
